summary: Samtse district is predominantly forested, covering 1,051.75 km² (80.8 %). Agricultural land accounts for 153.65 km² (11.8 %), while shrubland, water bodies, and sandy bank cover 52.94 km² (4.1 %), 13.63 km² (1.0 %), and 10.79 km² (0.8 %) respectively. Remaining land uses—meadows, built‑up areas, landslides, non‑built‑up, alpine scrubs, and rocky outcrops—constitute less than 1 % of the district.
